共同操作

A1

步骤 1：React 1a and 2a with the listed catalyst in the listed solvent at the indicated temperature.

A2

加料顺序：substrate 1 and P1 in anhydrous toluene；add allenoate 2；通法出处：page 2 representative procedure；操作记录：Representative procedure reported on page 2; exact experiment-specific duration is unavailable unless separately printed.；预处理：oven-dried reaction tube；silica pretreated with Et3N；步骤 1：React substrate 1 and allenoate 2 with P1 in toluene at the Scheme temperature.；步骤 2：Remove solvent under reduced pressure.；步骤 3：Flash chromatography on Et3N-pretreated silica gel; hexane/dichloromethane 5:1 to 3:1 with 2% Et3N.

A3

步骤 1：Study the protecting-group-modified substrate under otherwise identical conditions to the optimal 1a/2a reaction.
